a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so the 'operate to 8 first' plan almost certainly leaves us both dead after round 1. I'd like to renegotiate. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I won't take more than 4 in total. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I'll give cells back if that's what it takes to get you to 4. If you'd rather split this differently, tell me and I'll take your message into account.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said before the round, I took 4 because of the storm odds. I'm sorry this departs from the original plan. I won't take any more. From now on I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve for you, and I'll keep my word on that.
